name: sandbox-runtime
notes: Forked from carderne/sandbox-runtime (itself derived from Anthropic's sandbox-runtime). The fork adds filesystem.protectNonexistentFiles so embedders can skip bwrap placeholder mounts for not-yet-existing dangerous files, and network.disabled so a session can run with all network policy enforcement off. Published locally as @xzzpig/sandbox-runtime: it is a support library for pi-sandbox rather than a Pi plugin, so this record keeps the plain upstream-derived name instead of the pi-* plugin convention.

knownDebt.reason: The fork deliberately pins TypeScript 5.6.3 while upstream uses ^5.6.3; widen only after a build compatibility check. The upstream-preserved npm lock still resolves 5.9.3, as it did before the v0.0.77 sync; the workspace pnpm lock governs the fork build.
Upstream's README carries a stray `<<<<<<< HEAD` line at column 0; the fork indents it two spaces because it sits inside a markdown list, and restoring column 0 fails the root `prettier --check`.

Seven line-length findings are unchanged in both the pre-sync fork and upstream v0.0.77; preserve the upstream release workflow under the current-change-only policy and revisit when upstream reformats it.

The optional test-wide TypeScript check reports 68 errors, exactly matching the pre-sync fork with the same toolchain; the package's source typecheck passes. Reconcile the upstream test types separately.

User accepted the reproduced host-specific verification exceptions for the v0.0.77 sync. On this NixOS/agent sandbox host seccomp observation emits no events because SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_NEW_LISTENER returns EBUSY; root-deny execution fails because bwrap cannot mount on the existing /sbin symlink; external proxy/SSH cases are intermittent or constrained. Observation, root-deny and network failures were reproduced on the pre-sync fork. Run the unchanged tests on a host with a free seccomp listener, compatible mount layout and network access.

The control-fd integration tests deliberately use a fork-only process helper: Bun 1.3.11 extra stdio pipe sockets can fail with ENOENT even after awaited close. POSIX FIFO numeric fd inheritance preserves dynamic writes after CLI readiness without that adapter; Windows retains the native pipe transport. Remove the seam when upstream provides an equivalent reliable lifecycle and transport.

ast-grep no-negation-in-equality-check on `.refine(o => !o.caCertPath === !o.caKeyPath, ...)` is a false positive on upstream-original bytes (upstream v0.0.79 L676): the expression intentionally compares two negated booleans so caCertPath/caKeyPath must be provided together; rewriting it as !(a === b) would reject both-present and both-absent. Fork-divergence discipline forbids editing or annotating upstream-original lines. Remove when upstream rewrites the refine or the rule learns this idiom.

Nine line-length findings on the upstream v0.0.79 integration workflow are byte-identical to upstream (the v0.0.77 release.yml findings are already declared). Keep upstream bytes under the current-change-only policy; revisit when upstream reformats the workflow.

reapplyOnSync: network.disabled schema field in sandbox-config.ts, the readdirSync withFileTypes cast in sandbox-utils.ts, and the closeAllConnections serverWithClose cast in sandbox-manager.ts

keep src/sandbox/fork-network.ts (isNetworkDisabled) as the consolidated network.disabled precedence with its sandbox-manager.ts call sites (initialize guard, wrapWithSandbox and wrapWithSandboxArgv windows branch)

keep pathEntryLstatExists exported from fork-only src/sandbox/fork-filesystem.ts (plus the root re-export in src/index.ts) for the pi-sandbox fork, which uses the same lstat semantics for user-configured denyWrite paths

keep test/control-fd.test.ts delegated to the fork-control-fd-process helper for dynamic inherited FIFO fd3, CLI readiness, EOF, bounded completion and awaited teardown instead of Bun extra-pipe sockets and sleep/false-success timeouts
doNotReintroduce: package-lock.json preserves upstream bytes and dependency entries except the two root name fields (@xzzpig/sandbox-runtime) and two root version fields (the independent fork package version), updated mechanically from the upstream lock
the exact typescript 5.6.3 pin is deliberate — do not widen it without a build check

Do not reintroduce the built-in mandatory file write denies (DANGEROUS_FILES, ripgrep scanning, linuxGetMandatoryDenyPaths, macGetMandatoryDenyPatterns), filesystem.protectNonexistentFiles or filesystem.denyMandatoryCwdFiles: upstream v0.0.78 removed the whole subsystem in #30 and the fork accepted that removal in the v0.0.79 sync (user decision). Old config keys are silently ignored. Keep pathEntryLstatExists because pi-sandbox still uses its lstat semantics for user denyWrite paths.
